about: Generated still or shot (AI keyframe, storyboard, B-roll take) before it is used or sent to a paid video model. Works on an image file (one input) or a video take (a still every second plus the whole clip). no_text is calibrated (22 labelled frames: text overlays 0.85-0.92, text-free storyboards and takes at most 0.19). no_wipe: a take where the model invented a pillar crossing the frame scored 0.77, five clean takes from two projects 0.12-0.18. hands_ok has no expect (information only): wide shots with small hands sit at 0.43-0.50 whatever their quality; label 10+ close shots with `calibrate` before letting it block. To rank takes against a reference sheet or storyboard use `decide.py pick takes... --with ref.png:"Reference" --score ...`.
